component.name: Notolith
component.summary: A Markdown note app for developers

description.p: Notolith is a Markdown note app for developers, written in C++ and Qt: live preview, wikilinks and backlinks, search, tags, callouts, tables, maths, code blocks, the graph view, canvases and bases, in tabs and splits. It is a public beta: expect bugs and keep a backup of your vault.

It opens and works with Obsidian vaults: settings, hotkeys, bookmarks and layouts are read from the vault's .obsidian folder, and Obsidian's settings are never written back. Renaming a note updates the links to it in other notes.
